s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive facial swelling and sinus pressure with nasal septum deviation and proptosis
salient_findings: Heterogeneous mass in the left maxillary sinus with solid and cystic components
key_facts: Several months of sinus pressure and facial swelling
Several weeks of external deviation of the nasal septum
No significant past medical history
Left nasal mass on examination
Mild left-sided proptosis
CT scan showed a heterogeneous mass in the left maxillary sinus
Mass eroded the orbital floor, medial and posterior maxillary walls, and anterior ethmoid air cells
Displacement of inferior rectus without muscle invasion
Left maxillary alveolar ridge and several molar roots involved
Bony changes showed remodeling and thinning
Biopsy showed spindle cell process with significant multinucleated giant cells
Rare mitotic activity
No cytologic atypia

shortlist.label: Juvenile nasopharyngeal angiofibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Matches clinical presentation of nasal mass and facial swelling in a teenage girl

shortlist.label: Giant cell tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Biopsy results showing spindle cell process with significant multinucleated giant cells support this diagnosis

shortlist.label: Fibrous dysplasia
shortlist.why_kept: Bony changes with remodeling and thinning, and presence of a heterogeneous mass, are consistent with this condition

shortlist.label: Aneurysmal bone cyst
shortlist.why_kept: Imaging findings of a heterogeneous mass with solid and cystic components, and bony erosion, are plausible for this diagnosis

shortlist.label: Ossifying fibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Clinical presentation and imaging findings of a nasal mass with bony involvement are consistent with this rare tumor

rule_in.why: it predominantly occurs in teenage boys but can occur in teenage girls

it often presents with facial swelling

rule_out.why: facial swelling is compatible with all candidates

trace.fact: Chief complaint: external deviation of nasal septum

rule_out.why: it is compatible with all candidates
it typically presents with rapid growth

trace.fact: Duration of nasal septum deviation: several weeks

rule_out.why: duration is compatible with all candidates

trace.fact: Past medical history: no significant history

rule_in.why: it does not discriminate between candidates
